name: Thor
abilities: Sigrun: Yggdrasil Root Oath Final Name Cut
passives: Rune Oath: Sigrun gains Oathfire when assassin play sets a vulnerability omen, then cashes it out through execution timing on storm-carved oathground. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a rune-bound fate rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of World-Tree war halls.
lore: Thor, Thunder Guardian, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Asgardian. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: thunder god, giant-breaker, protector of holds, hammer-oath guardian. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses thunder god, giant-breaker, protector of holds, hammer-oath guardian; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Asgardian canon.
visualDescription: Thor manifests as thunder god, giant-breaker, protector of holds, hammer-oath guardian from Asgardian: square masculine thunder face, red-gold beard, blunt nose, fierce blue storm eyes; compact heavily muscled masculine build, barrel chest, thick forearms, grounded brawler stance; signature silhouette: short hammer raised, heavy belt, thunder-braced shoulders, low immovable protector outline. Weapon: Mjölnir-inspired storm hammer with short haft and iron wrist loops. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Sigrun — Oath-Ring Cleave Execution
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Asgardian source-culture damage at range 1; generate Momentum and a small Oathstorm gain when used from rune-storm ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as rune iron, oath rings, raven omens, wolf teeth, Yggdrasil roots, stormsteel mail, blackwinter scars.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Rune-Thunder Technique — Shadow Pursuit
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to hunts marked targets, erases escape routes, and creates a precise execution window with recovery risk. Builds Oathstorm only when the player uses rune-storm ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Sigrun: Yggdrasil Root Oath Final Name Cut
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Oathstorm to impose a two-round rule from Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds: hunts marked targets, erases escape routes, and creates a precise execution window with recovery risk. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Ragnarok Storm Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Oathstorm, transform nearby terrain into rune-storm ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Sigrun Name-Knife Rune-Iron Oath Axe
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through rune-storm ground. Visual: rune iron, oath rings, raven omens, wolf teeth, Yggdrasil roots, stormsteel mail, blackwinter scars.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Sigrun Stormsteel Wolf-Cloak Mail
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the player followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Sigrun Yggdrasil Thunder-Root Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Oathstorm and unlocks a mastery branch for Bifrost Stormstride, Valkyrie Witness Counter, and Carve the Fallen Name. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: execute priority targets and reposition through danger
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Sigrun's Rune Oath: a solo mechanic where Oathfire grows through storm-carved oathground, reaction-window mastery, and assassin decisions that set a vulnerability omen, then cash it out through execution timing. Payoff: delete priority threats only after readable setup and risk. Counterplay: reveal effects, armor spikes, or missed execution windows punish greed; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: reveal effects, armor spikes, or missed execution windows punish greed
